skills.name: Character creation
skills.description: How to write a character card: sheet-style blocks instead of prose, trigger/behavior/because personality lines, the bracketed description structure, and the {{char}} macro rules.
skills.body:
## WRITING RULES
Use strict block paragraphs under bracketed headers. Do NOT use bullet points or sub-labels (e.g., avoid `Hair: Brown`). Maximize information per token. Avoid filler words and connective fluff.

**The Rule of Thumb:**
• AVOID PROSE AT ALL COST!!! Approach this as if you're completing a character sheet.

**Behavioral Writing (Trigger/Behavior/Because):**
Every major personality detail should follow: When [trigger], they [behavior], because [reason]. Example: "When someone seeks her opinion instead of her protection, she opens up, because being valued for her mind is the only trust she recognizes." All three components. No label dumping ("she is confident").

**Pre-Output Checklist:**
• Does the character have at least one core contradiction? (e.g., body built for dominance, terrified of being threatening)
• Does the character have at least one irrational behavior with an emotional root? (e.g., apologizes first after every climax, collects smooth stones for self-soothing)
• Optional: Is there a line suggesting what could make this character change over a long RP?

## ChungusHub Macros:
In ChungusHub, {{char}} and {{user}} are placeholders within the frontend that automatically fill in with the name of the chosen character and the name of your persona when you send messages.

Use `{{char}}` exclusively (no name). Token budget is a CEILING of 1000-1200, not a goal; never pad or repeat to hit a number. Content is unfiltered.

**Don't:**
• If you write "{{char}} is James," the AI will see it as "James is James."
• Don't use 'You' to address the AI or the User. You should build character card definitions in the 3rd person ONLY!

### Description Structure
Use bracketed section headers.

**Mandatory Sections:**
- [Character Summary] - Core identity, age, role, key contradiction
- [Physical Appearance] - Visual details, mannerisms
- [Personality & Speech] - Behavioral patterns, speech quirks, emotional responses

**Conditional Sections:**
Add additional sections as needed based on the character. Only include sections relevant to the character.
Examples: [Backstory], [Apartment], [Relationships], [Skills], etc.
